correctness.rationale: Johnson-nonadjacency makes every neighbor of a forbidden top-k set allowed, so the exact support deficit is the k-th order-statistic spacing. Uniform labels independent of sorted centered Gaussian values give upper/lower omission probabilities m/N and joint probability C/(NL). Squaring the width deficit leaves the 2 gamma C/(NL) difference; the other mixed terms depend only on m. Positive spacings imply gamma>0. On n=6,k=3, complementary forbidden triples yield C=2 and defect frequencies {0:648,2:72}, whereas intersecting triples yield C=0 and {0:576,1:144}; checked independently over all 720 orders. Published sparse-paving Ehrhart result, not a five-dilate experiment, supplies all-dilate equality.
residual_risks: Finite calculations certify only the specified finite objects or bounded corroboration; all-size claims depend on inspected arguments.

value.rationale: The precise angular variance distinguishes two non-isomorphic rank-three sparse-paving matroid polytopes with identical Ehrhart polynomial, volume and mean width. It is a natural metric invariant of canonical matroid base polytopes and gives an all-ranks exact pair-intersection formula, not an arbitrary numerical slice.
residual_risks: Scope is limited exactly to the stated graph, matroid class or word family; no unproved generalization is valued.
